meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'ейчас').

examples.text: У меня сейчас сплошные нервы и стресс.
examples.trans: I have nothing but nerves and stress right now.

examples.text: Сейчас это уже не ресторан, а печка.
examples.trans: Right now it is no longer a restaurant, it is a furnace.

examples.text: Чего ты сейчас так плохо играешь?
examples.trans: Why are you acting so poorly right now?

meanings.note: Prefix 'при-' indicates approaching, attachment, or slight degree of action (stem 'мчаться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'I will race over'.

related.gloss: to I will race over (prefixed perfective)
not to I will race over (negated infinitive)

examples.text: Надо всё сделать и примчаться вовремя.
examples.trans: We need to do everything and I will race over on time.

examples.text: На нашей кухне все умеют примчаться.
examples.trans: In our kitchen everyone knows how to I will race over.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'already', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Сейчас это уже не ресторан, а печка.
examples.trans: Right now it is no longer a restaurant, it is a furnace.

examples.text: Я уже всё там менял.
examples.trans: I have already changed everything there.

examples.text: Баринова, что ли? Он мне даром не нужен.
examples.trans: Barinov, you mean? I do not need him even for free.

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'is flying', paired with 'полететь'.

examples.text: Летим! Хоп!
examples.trans: We're flying! Hop!

examples.text: Завтра я лечу в Москву.
examples.trans: Tomorrow I'm flying to Moscow.

examples.text: Все видели, как ты из окна летел.
examples.trans: Everyone saw you fly out the window.

meanings.note: Prefix 'об-' ('around, about') marks encirclement or comprehensive action (stem 'ратно'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Возвращайся, Витя, обратно в наш ресторан.
examples.trans: Come back, Vitya, back to our restaurant.

examples.text: Возвращайся скорее обратно ко мне.
examples.trans: Come back to me as soon as possible.

examples.text: Мне надо срочно с бумагами разобраться.
examples.trans: I urgently need to sort out some paperwork.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian spatial or relational preposition meaning 'to, towards', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Димочка, ну не расстраивайся ты так.
examples.trans: Dimochka, well do not get so upset.

examples.text: Я новый контракт не могу подписать.
examples.trans: I cannot sign a new contract.

examples.text: Сейчас это уже не ресторан, а печка.
examples.trans: Right now it is no longer a restaurant, it is a furnace.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian spatial or relational preposition meaning 'on, onto', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Значит, тебе нужно там что-то менять.
examples.trans: Then you need to change something there.

examples.text: Если не нужен, может, назад его вернёшь?
examples.trans: If you do not need him, maybe you will give him back?

examples.text: Хочешь найти шляпку, тогда следуй подсказкам.
examples.trans: If you want to find the hat, follow the clues.

meanings.note: Entered Russian via Polish 'kuchnia' and Middle High German 'küchen', ultimately from Late Latin 'coquina' (from 'coquere', to cook).

examples.text: Найди способ, как уменьшить расходы кухни.
examples.trans: Find a way to reduce the kitchen's expenses.

examples.text: Я составил подробный план оптимизации кухни.
examples.trans: I drew up a detailed kitchen optimization plan.

examples.text: Всё, иди на кухню, я занят.
examples.trans: That is it, go to the kitchen, I am busy.
